slides.texte_overlay:
Things worth buying
before you turn 30
A good chef's knife. One sharp, quality knife makes cooking faster, safer and more enjoyable. You'll use it every day for decades.
A proper winter coat. Warm, well cut, in a neutral colour. It's the piece people see most for months, so it's worth getting right.
A basic toolbox. Hammer, screwdrivers, a drill, a level. Being able to fix and build things at home makes you feel capable.
A comfortable desk chair. If you work or study at home, your back will thank you for years. Cheap chairs cost you in pain later.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Of everything I've invested in, my curiosity has paid back the most.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Of everything I've invested in, my curiosity has paid back the most.

slides.texte_overlay: A good suitcase. Sturdy wheels, simple design, carry-on size. Travel becomes easier and more pleasant when your luggage doesn't fight you.
Quality running shoes. Whether you run or just walk a lot, good shoes protect your knees and back. Your body is worth it.
